ops.title: PR 1316: always return pending when a judgment is first submitted
ops.description: Owner: PR #1316 implementation lane (agentic-judge-landing). Static review only; no tests run. Evidence: desk-runner.py:1896-1901 and tests/test_desk_runner.py:7431-7434. judgment checks future.done immediately after submit, so a fast callback or evidence exception can be collected on its initial call. This violates the stated asking-pass-pending contract and makes the new test race: unread may raise at unguarded line 7431 instead of the later pytest.raises. Next executable step: return (False, None) directly after inserting a newly submitted future; collect only a future that was already present. Add a deterministic already-completed Future regression in CI.

ops.text: The first call always returns pending, even when submit returns an already-completed successful or failed future.
Only a later call returns the verdict or raises the evidence-read exception.
